tasks.title: Reconcile the net transition and draft migration guidance
tasks.goal: Derive a complete DP1-to-candidate migration document from actual delivered changes rather than completed task counts.
steps: After all required milestone outcomes, DOCS.3 and BIND.2, independently enumerate the actual DP1-to-candidate source/package/interface delta across every bound repository. Reconcile the full contribution set, including unplanned repairs, same-version package changes, merges, reverts and superseding changes.

Compare net capabilities, commands/defaults, authored/derived data, source/package identities, configuration/boot, installation/deployment and documentation topics with the exact DP1 census. Require every difference to have permanent impact evidence or separate supported user/documentation no-impact reasons; counts and task labels are not a coverage oracle.

Produce the deterministic draft from retained records with the accepted assembler grammar. Edit MIGRATION.md into usable user guidance while retaining links to canonical facts; store material reviewed editorial facts in permanent sources so a new draft cannot silently erase them.

Write a scenario/action matrix distinguishing automatic supported converters, manual authored edits, rebuild/re-fetch of derived artifacts, explicit no action and unsupported transitions. Include additions/removals/renames and the actual implications of mutable 1.0.0 captures without treating DP labels as semantic version bumps.

For each relevant scenario state prerequisites and exact capture/version detection, backup scope, preview/dry-run availability, ordered apply steps, verification, repeated-run behavior, partial failure inspection/recovery and real limits. A workflow with no dry-run or rollback support says so; never invent commands or promise lossless recovery.

Record discrepancies found by independent reconciliation and bring any product/documentation correction back through contribution accounting. Refresh only affected guide/map/evidence after the correction; retain DP2 as a candidate.
positive_cases: A reverted implementation produces no net migration step while its contribution history remains accounted.
A new feature is documented even if no DP1 file must change.
Two 1.0.0 package captures yield an exact content-based detection and action distinction.
negative_cases: A missing out-of-plan repair, deleted capability row or unexplained no-impact claim blocks net reconciliation.
A recipe assembled from desired design rather than real commands cannot be labelled automatic.
A migration guide cannot equate derivative-data rebuilding with authored-file conversion or promise unsupported rollback.
checks: TO CREATE/USE AFTER BASE.2: python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/preview-transition/tests -p test_*.py
TO CREATE/USE AFTER BASE.2: python -B tools/preview-transition/check.py --transition docs/releases/developer-preview-1-to-2/transition.json --mode release --stage reviewed --format json
TO CREATE/USE AFTER BASE.2: python -B tools/preview-transition/assemble.py --transition docs/releases/developer-preview-1-to-2/transition.json --output-dir <bound-reviewed-draft-directory>
acceptance: The full exact-scope net delta is reconciled independently of the task denominator and each user-facing action points to permanent facts and applicable proof.
MIGRATION.md is a concrete draft for the real candidate with a complete action/limitation matrix; DP2 remains unfinalized.
tasks.safe_stop: Stop with reconciled candidate guidance; do not publish or declare DP2 until rehearsal and post-retirement closure.

tasks.title: Rehearse migration guidance on isolated captured states
tasks.goal: Test the guide as an operator would follow it, including preservation and failed or interrupted attempts.
steps: Build a finite rehearsal matrix from MIGRATION.md: retained DP1 captures plus representative authored project/configuration/package states, current DP2 candidate artifacts and relevant target/client combinations. Bind isolated temporary roots and any required Docker engine before running a scenario.

Run the documented instructions verbatim where executable, preserving before-images of authored input and tracking exact command, toolchain, artifact and platform subjects. Include a clean installation comparison so migration-specific assumptions are not confused with general setup failures.

Exercise unknown or ambiguous versions, changed source preconditions, invalid inputs, partial writes/provider interruption and repeated execution for applicable scenarios. Inspect actual postconditions before retry; assert documented recovery or explicit refusal with the retained state, never assume an error means no side effect.

Verify comments/user values and selected intent survive supported authored conversions; verify derived state is regenerated from pinned inputs as documented. For manual steps inspect the resulting reader-visible behavior instead of calling prose presence a successful migration.

Retain compact machine-readable scenario evidence and human conclusions under permanent evidence/. Correct guidance or return product defects to root for accounted repair; rerun only proofs whose exact inputs or claims changed. Mark missing native resources and unsupported cases truthfully.
positive_cases: A captured DP1 project reaches the same intended reader-visible configuration as a corresponding fresh DP2 setup.
Repeating an exact supported migration is idempotent or yields the documented explicit refusal.
An interruption fixture demonstrates the actual retained state and supported recovery path.
negative_cases: A real host installation, external publication or another worker's checkout is not an allowed test fixture.
Unexercised paths, unavailable platforms and fake rollback success cannot satisfy a required scenario.
A rerun after uncertain effects must not duplicate writes or erase retained before-state.

acceptance: Every required applicable migration scenario has meaningful retained positive/negative/repeat/recovery evidence for the exact candidate, or a specific blocker remains.
The guide's claims agree with observed preservation and failure behavior; no unperformed public/host action is implied.

tasks.title: Prepare permanent transition proof for campaign retirement
tasks.goal: Leave a complete permanent proof that can finalize DP2 after temporary planning scaffolding is gone.
steps: Reconcile all accepted impact records, current documentation-map, MIGRATION.md and rehearsal evidence into a candidate transition package. Remove semantic dependence on NEXT task IDs, temporary coverage bridge, seed, frozen campaign inputs or personal plan; permanent records retain their own identities and references.

Implement and test the permanent retired-mode validator using only permanent schemas, source/capture scope definitions, impact records, documentation and retained evidence. Test it in a fixture with campaign paths absent before allowing final campaign removal.

Define the final attestation procedure for NEXT-CLOSE.3 after scaffold removal: capture source/documentation commit C, prove exact product-scope identity and no unaccounted later delta, run permanent checks with temporary paths absent, then write the final metadata-only attestation referencing C.

Avoid a cyclic self-hash: the later attestation commit records C and the validated permanent-input digests; its own metadata is outside the product subject by an explicit narrow classification, not a blanket exclusion of docs or release files. Independently account for any later product or documentation edit and rerun affected evidence.

Keep transition state DP2=candidate at this task's completion. The final close gate alone may set finalized after checking actual scaffold absence, current product/documentation equality and all required permanent proof. Neither finalization nor a DP label publishes, freezes versions or activates public support obligations.
positive_cases: The permanent validator succeeds against a fully evidenced fixture after the campaign directories are removed.
A final metadata-only attestation can identify source/documentation commit C without hashing itself.
A later meaningful documentation or product edit is detected and requires renewed accounting/evidence.
negative_cases: Permanent validation that imports campaign.py, task IDs or a personal plan fails retirement readiness.
A broad release-directory exclusion, stale source capture or missing required rehearsal cannot be hidden by an attestation.
DP2 cannot be finalized before actual removal or inferred from the accepted RELEASE.3 task.

A precise finalization recipe separates candidate validation, actual scaffold removal, exact post-removal proof and metadata-only attestation.
DP2 remains candidate until the root-owned final close gate executes the permanent proof on the real final tree.
